description.value:
Ability Scores: DEX, CON, WIS

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatAlertOrigin1]{Alert}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from DEC, INS, PER, STE

Feature: Ear to the Ground

You are in frequent contact with people involved in the lucrative and dangerous business of hunting fugitive marks. You know where to find underworld cantinas, corporate security terminals, and illicit comms relays. When searching for leads on target individuals or missing cargo, local law enforcement contacts and black-market fixers are willing to share rumors, provided you maintain professional etiquette and do not burn their covers.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I assess the exits and sightlines of every room I walk into before speaking.
2I speak in brief, clipped sentences. Long conversations get people shot.
3I keep a worn holotag of a bounty that got away; it reminds me never to get sloppy.
4Money talks, but professional reputation keeps you breathing in the outer colonies.
5I have a morbid sense of humor honed from pulling bounties out of airlocks.
6I never draw my blaster unless I have already committed to pulling the trigger.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Professionalism. A contract is sacred. Once I take a retainer, I see it through. (Lawful)
2Freedom. Freelancing keeps me untethered from corporate control. (Chaotic)
3Survival. The only victory that matters is living to collect the fee. (Neutral)
4Justice. Some targets deserve the cell or the grave; I ensure they get it. (Good)
5Greed. Credits rule this solar system, and I intend to amass a mountain of them. (Evil)
6Code. I never hunt children, indentured laborers, or the genuinely helpless. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1My mentor was killed by an elusive syndicate syndicate target; I will bring them in dead or alive.
2I owe my custom pursuit gunship to a loan shark who still holds the override codes.
3A former bounty saved my life when a gig went sideways; I owe them a favor no matter what.
4The guild syndicate that issued my license is the only family I acknowledge.
5Everything I earn goes toward buying my family out of an Omni-Tek labor indent.
6I wear the insignia of an old PMC squad that was betrayed and wiped out.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1I assume everyone has a hidden angle, price tag, or bounty on their head.
2I cannot resist a dangerous bet or high-risk bounty with obscene payouts.
3My ruthlessness makes it difficult to maintain civil relationships with gentle people.
4When an alarm sounds, my immediate instinct is to draw weapons and shoot first.
5I hold long grudges against anyone who stands between me and a contracted target.
6I rely heavily on combat stims to stay alert during multi-day surveillance stakes.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your DEX, CON, WIS scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: dec, ins, per, ste.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Alert origin feat.
